name: Grace Sherman
source: A bright and determined freshman at the Martenden House, Grace does not possess outstanding talents, but she more than makes up for it in hard work. Sometimes it seems she only has fun when she studies. Grace dreams of excelling in the field of potions and inventing her own potion recipes.
